answer: Each new agent must be vouched for by 3 established members, who each lock 8 POA for 40 epochs. If a vouched identity is later flagged, all three lose 50% of the lock, so a sybil ring pays a rising price: the n-th fake needs 24 POA of fresh collateral and a growing risk of slashing. A cipher-signed vouch is logged on chain, and the pulse of each epoch triggers a random audit of 5 percent of vouch ridge clusters by independent graders.
